Some personal review of faculties that I did courses with in my BBA (for the juniors): 
MKT202 aws- teaching style is ok but too rude and marking is not that well. Questions are easy but lengthy
MKT202: afh: book porte hobe, questions are easy. U can take him and study book to understand concepts. 
ACT201 and 202- rhf (ruhaini fatema Mam) she is very strict but very knowledgeable, her practice maths are easy and that comes in the exam as well.
Bus172: mhm sir. Very knowledgeable, teaches extremely well. But grading is not very good. Even if u feel that u will try, u just can’t get over B that easily.A simple mistake in maths (plus minus sign or decimal places) will get ur entire 10 marks cut.Exam questions are tricky to understand, very lengthy exam.
Bus173: KNI sir. Unfortunately, he is no more.
Eco101: sif. Mam is very strict, marks are hard to score. She is very knowledgeable. Just read her slides and be attentive in class. A- is a must then.
Eng103: ssy. She is the best! Sakiba ferdousy miss! Just follow the class, B + is easy to get
Pbh101: hrh sir. A bit boring but everything comes exactly from slides. If u can write at least 80% as slides, u get the full marks. suggestions are given. exam e he will tell u when u r stuck at any point.
Env107: kbu. Just slide based. English speech delivery is very poor. But getting A is damn easy.
Mis105: fhm. Onk onk easy going. Slides porlei hoy. Book porte hoy na. Suggestion diye dei. Easily A pawa jay
Eco104: apk, she is not organised. Cannot teach well but tries very hard. Vocal is not loud and a student may struggle. She is a NSU graduate. 
Fin254: SNT. Well she is a sweetheart. Maths are easy, can teach well. Helps u during exam and questions r easy. Avg B+ grading.
Mgt210: Neh mam. Just as pretty she is...very strict as well. Must read book to get A or A-. Slides are enough to get B/B+...
Bus251: SQT. Class e he is very helpful but exam paper checking e he is damn strict. Grading system is poor. Questions are average but students find it struggling to do a course with him. Onek marks kate. Book must be followed to do good.

Faculty Review
Faculty Initial: Amtr
Amreen Talukdar
Course: MGT368
She will take 2 quizzes, 2 group case studies, and will count the best 1. 1 solo case on a local entrepreneur business, 1mid exam& final. And obviously, a Business plan (group of 5-7, depending on the number of students in that section) & group presentation.
If you attend her classes regularly and remain attentive, you won't face any problems in the exams. Her quizzes are very easy, and all content will come from the slides.
In the midterm and final exams, there will be two sections: MCQ and SAQ. All questions will be based on the slides and class lectures.
There are two types of SAQs: some will be straightforward questions taken directly from the slides, while others will require analytical responses. For example, you might be asked, "As an entrepreneur, what would you do?" or "What would you suggest?"
In the midterm and final exams, Miss expects direct answers; she doesn't like lengthy answers, and there will be a page limit. The same applies to group case studies; your answers should be on point.
For solo case studies, you've to take an interview with an entrepreneur who is running their business and has a trade licence. The assignment should look like a storytelling of the entrepreneur's journey, how they started the business, and how they are currently running it.
Group project / Business plan will contain 20% marks and 5% in your group presentation. So, you must put effort into that. Be innovative, creative, and realistic. You have to convince her that this business can actually work and that you can make profits in the future.
Try to bring your product samples on your presentation day, or any poster, flyer, or anything, for example: you can build a website or blueprints of your service/ product. She really appreciates your hard work.
Also, for the class participation mark, you must ask questions to other groups after their presentation.
Her grading will be fair, but I think she might curve if you are missing 0.5-1 mark. Overall, she is very nice, teaches effectively, and makes the material easy to understand.
To achieve your desired grades, you need to put effort into the solo case and the group project, as they will contain 35% of the total marks. The exams are relatively easy—just follow the lectures and the slides, and that should be sufficient to earn good marks.
Best of Luck.

text:
HIGHLIGHT: MGT368(Entrepreneurship)

Note : This is just my personal opinion. Ya'll are free to take it or ignore it.

I have noticed that a lot of students in their 3rd/4th semesters preadvising for this course. Which, if I am being honest isn't ideal and might be straight up suic!de for some. MGT368 is a heavyweight course. You need basic knowledge of every 200 level course in order to just 'function' in this course, let alone ace it. It becomes more evident when you're writing the report/business plan. You need to have a good grasp on MKT, FIN, ACT, INB in order to write the business plan. And the business plan itself is FAR from a walk in the park. Even if you get past everything else, putting the numbers properly will give you headaches. This course requires you to construct a real business from scratch til the end (til contingency plans in case your company fails) and it involves real numbers too. As somebody who had completed MGT368 in their 5th semester, I felt as though it was a little too soon. I had great teammates, all of which were workhorses and two of them who were really good with numbers. It saved me and my team from having a really hard time with the project. Otherwise, I probably would have been swimming with the fishes. I had a classmate that took this course in her second semester without probably knowing how heavy this course was and I can assure you she did not have a good time doing Entrepreneurship.

Long story short : Those of you are in your 3rd/4th semester, please refrain from taking this course THIS early. Even our faculty had mentioned in the first class "I assume that y'all have finished all the 200 level courses before we begin?" So, if you want to have a smooth sailing in this course, you know what to do best now


Note : I know some people have taken it early on and did well. But, it doesn't apply for most cases, hence, I felt the necessity of writing this post. Y'all are free to ignore it if you want.
